cuts.speaker: 스카이본 마법사
cuts.dialogue:
수도원에서 이거 떴는데
왜 나만 주사위 창이 안 떠?
cuts.visual_prompt: High-angle three-quarter shot in cute 2.5-head chibi SD style on pure #FFFFFF background: left, Skyborne Mage (crystal staff stowed diagonally on her back) holds up a single glowing golden gem pendant necklace amulet on a thin gold necklace chain, tilting her head in innocent confusion over an open wooden treasure chest on minimal stone tiles. Right, Gnome Rogue (daggers sheathed at waist) looks back over her shoulder with a sneaky smirk.

cuts.speaker: 스카이본 마법사
cuts.dialogue:
혹시 나 렙 낮아서
주사위 창 안 뜨는 거야?
cuts.visual_prompt: Over-the-shoulder medium shot from behind Tauren Druid on the right looking toward Skyborne Mage on the left, cute 2.5-head chibi SD style on a pure #FFFFFF background. Skyborne Mage holds out empty palms with a genuinely puzzled expression and her staff stowed on her back, while Tauren Druid leans in listening carefully with her leafy wooden staff stowed.

cuts.speaker: 타우렌 드루이드
cuts.dialogue:
잠깐, 담당자 루팅이잖아!
파장이 뉴비 등쳐먹으려 했네!
cuts.visual_prompt: Dynamic low-angle shot of cute 2.5-head chibi SD characters on a pure #FFFFFF background. Tauren Druid on the right gasps with wide shocked eyes and raised hands pointing at a tiny floating golden padlock icon, her leafy staff stowed on her back, while Skyborne Mage on the left blinks in sudden realization.

Silent extreme big close-up bust-up filling 80 percent of the frame height centered on cute 2.5-head chibi SD Gnome Rogue against a pure #FFFFFF background. She freezes in sheer panic with pinpoint pupils, pale shocked face, and heavy cartoon cold sweat droplets pouring down her cheeks, daggers completely hidden.

cuts.speaker: 타우렌 드루이드
cuts.dialogue:
당장 주사위로 안 바꾸면
길드 추방에 평생 노힐이다?!
cuts.visual_prompt: Dramatic angled confrontation of cute 2.5-head chibi SD characters on a pure #FFFFFF background. Towering furious Tauren Druid on the left leans forward glaring menacingly with clenched fists and staff stowed on her back, looming over tiny trembling Gnome Rogue on the right who raises both empty hands in desperate surrender.

cuts.speaker: 노움 도적
cuts.dialogue:
바꿨어! 바로 주사위 돌렸어!
착각이지, 주려고 했던 거야!
cuts.visual_prompt: Side-profile comedic aftermath of cute 2.5-head chibi SD characters on a pure #FFFFFF background. On the left, Gnome Rogue sweats nervously while gesturing toward a floating chunky 6-sided white-and-gold cube with round dot pips only (no digits); on the right, Skyborne Mage happily cradles the sparkling amulet in empty hands with her crystal staff stowed on her back.
